Freeform configuration values are sensitive.

notes.text: Available from cPanel 74. Basic selects Basic WebHost Manager Setup; Main selects Tweak Settings. Module names are case-sensitive. Unchanged backups do not rewrite configuration.

Both arguments are required from the body schema despite absent requestBody.required. Sends literal module text followed by a single Upload; routing stays in the WHM query. This can affect server-wide configuration; no retry, rollback, transactional or restart guarantee is provided.
The formal multipart schema and upload prose govern this request. The empty JSON HTTP sample and its port 2083 are inconsistent examples, not alternate transport or routing contracts.

Reviewer inspection of the 11.138.0.19 server source found that apply_module_settings rejects invalid values, restores their old values and logs warnings, while _restore_config discards reject details. Success does not mean every setting was applied. Re-read the configuration of interest after the call.

An unchanged backup does not rewrite the configuration file, but the reviewed 11.138.0.19 handler sets success metadata only when settings are modified. An unchanged restore may therefore surface as an error; the compiled wrapper behavior remains unverified under 8x0.30.7.1. Offline envelope handling raises InvalidResponseException for a missing metadata.result and ApiErrorException for result 0; these are not observed restore responses.

Reviewer source inspection on 11.138.0.19 indicates a restore may retain a root-only uploaded backup at /root/tmp/Cpanel_Form_file.upload.*. Restore-specific retention remains unverified; a separate read-only WHM file-part check observed a mode-0600 copy. Backups can contain configuration secrets; account for possible server-side retention.
